title: Pope's four daughters and photographs
summary: Pope's four daughters sang in New York and Canada; he has no band photographs.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Thank you. You have a picture of me all. You know, they... I had four daughters. They sang in New York, you know. Stayed there quite a while. Until one died, I broke up the key. Really? Yes. They gave them pretty well. Mm-hmm. They stayed there quite a while. They went to Canada and stayed there two, three months. In one place. Mm-hmm.
Do you have any photographs of the band? How is that? Do you have any photographs of the Excelsior band? No.
I don't know. This is when we went for the show business.
Oh, yes. Very, very, very good. Four sisters.
